description:
The ~F sigil currently delegates to Phoenix.LiveView.TagEngine, which requires an `assigns` variable in lexical scope — a vestigial artifact of Phoenix's change-tracking model that Filament does not use. The goal is to own the full rendering pipeline end-to-end.

KEY ARCHITECTURAL INSIGHT: the dynamic fn in %Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered{} is re-evaluated by Phoenix's diff engine outside the Filament render context. Every workaround written so far (use_memo, hoisting child renders, assigns = {} hack) exists because work is happening inside that closure. The fix is structural: all real work — hooks, child renders, event registration — must be hoisted to the linear body of the render function, where the fiber context is active. The dynamic fn must be trivial: it only returns already-bound locals.

CENTRAL FILES:
- lib/filament/sigil_f.ex — ~F entry point; calls VNodeCompiler.compile/2
- lib/filament/vnode_compiler.ex — current pipeline: TagEngine → transform_at_assigns → wrap_in_use_memo; emits iodata, NOT a %Rendered{} struct
- lib/filament/html_engine.ex — thin wrapper over Phoenix.LiveView.HTMLEngine
- lib/filament/component.ex — defcomponent macro; imports SigilF
- deps/phoenix_live_view/lib/phoenix_live_view/tag_engine.ex — source to fork
- deps/phoenix_live_view/lib/phoenix_live_view/html_engine.ex — source to fork
- examples/todo/lib/todo_web/components/ — all example components to be updated

%Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered{} CONTRACT:
  static:      [String.t()]                        — compile-time constant HTML string list
  dynamic:     fn(bool) -> [dyn()] end             — bool arg is always false; each element is iodata | %Rendered{} | %Comprehension{} | nil
  fingerprint: integer                             — MD5 of :erlang.term_to_binary([block | statics]), computed at compile time; required for diff correctness
  root:        nil                                 — leave nil for function components
  caller:      {module, {fn, arity}, file, line}  — from __CALLER__; enables diff-phase stack traces

Fingerprint algorithm (from Phoenix source):
  <<fp::8*16>> = :erlang.md5(:erlang.term_to_binary([block | statics]))

SCOPE: no backward compatibility required. ~F becomes the new behavior. No new sigil.
title: Own the Renderer: fork TagEngine, emit %Rendered{} directly, JSX syntax in ~F
